articles.summary: ROANOKE, Va. (September 28, 2026)—The Board of Directors of RGC Resources, Inc. (Nasdaq: RGCO) declared a quarterly dividend of $0.2175 per share on the Company’s common stock. The dividend will be paid on November 2, 2026 to shareholders of record on October 16, 2026. This is the Company’s 330th consecutive quarterly cash dividend. RGC Resources,
articles.title: RGC Resources, Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend
